pairs.subject: standards-layered-runtime
pairs.evidence: src/api/__tests__/system.test.ts:3 These files are Vitest unit tests that mock Tauri `invoke` to check the IPC wrappers. They do not embed or package a guest-language runtime, so the subject's precondition (an embeddable engine split into standards packages, an extras layer and a CLI) does not hold. I searched src/api and src/api/__tests__ for WinterTC, boa_engine, boa_runtime, deno_core, quickjs, JsValue, register_extensions and 'guest language' and found 0 hits, and no Cargo.toml in the repo depends on boa_, deno_core, rquickjs or v8.
